name: zoolutions
description: Shared Claude Code machinery for the zoolutions, enode and getzazu repositories. Knowledge stays in each repo; the machinery that reads and grows it lives here.

plugins.name: lode
plugins.description: Durable per-repo project memory (a lode) plus a pre-PR gate: fresh-context reviewers check the branch diff against the repo's own rules and learnings before anything is pushed, and every accepted finding is written back so the next gate is stricter.
